    def handle_conversational_flow(self, first_response, prompt_used, expected_response, index, max_turns=3, user_type: Optional[str] = None):
        """
        Handle multi-turn conversation with metadata-aware evaluation.
    
        Iterates through conversation turns, checking metadata type at each step:
        - type == "info": Validates with answer_correctness and exits early
        - type == "error": Fails immediately
        - Otherwise: Continues to next turn up to max_turns
    
        If max_turns is exhausted without info/error, evaluates full conversation
        with conversational-professionalism metric.
    
        Args:
            first_response: Initial LLM response
            prompt_used: Original user prompt
            expected_response: Expected final response
            index: Index for attachment naming
            max_turns: Maximum conversation turns to attempt (default: 3)
            user_type: Optional user type to use for client.ask (e.g., "Non Admin")
        """
        turns = [
            {"role": "user", "content": prompt_used},
            {"role": "assistant", "content": first_response}
        ]
    
        current_prompt, current_response = prompt_used, first_response
    
        for turn in range(1, max_turns):
            reply = self.generate.reply_for_llm(
                current_response, self.section_name, self.entry_name, current_prompt, turns=turns, section_desc=self.section_desc, item_desc=self.item_desc
            )
            # Add user reply to turns as soon as it is generated
            turns.append({"role": "user", "content": reply})
            ask_result = self.client.ask(session_id=self.session_id, user_query=reply, user_type=user_type)
            next_response = ask_result["text_response"]
            next_metadata = ask_result.get("metadata")
            next_type = next_metadata.get("type") if next_metadata else None
            # Add assistant response to turns as soon as it is captured
            turns.append({"role": "assistant", "content": next_response})
    
            # Attach full turns before any validation/branching
            allure.attach(str(turns), name=f"Turns [{index}]", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
    
            # Check metadata type for early exit/specialized handling
            if next_type == "info":
                # Validate metadata names when agent returns an info response
    
                allure.attach(
                    str(next_metadata),
                    name=f"Turn {turn+1} Metadata [{index}]",
                    attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT
                )
                allure.attach(
                    str(expected_response),
                    name=f"Expected Response [{index}]",
                    attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT
                )
                allure.attach(
                    str(next_response),
                    name=f"Turn {turn+1} Response [{index}]",
                    attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT
                )
                # Attach turns before evaluation
                allure.attach(str(turns), name=f"Turns [{index}]", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
                self.validate_metadata_match(next_metadata)
                self.evaluate_answer_correctness(reply, next_response, expected_response, index)
                return  # Exit early on success
            elif next_type == "error":
                # Attach full turns before failing
                allure.attach(str(turns), name=f"Turns [{index}]", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
                allure.attach(
                    str(next_metadata),
                    name=f"Turn {turn+1} Metadata [{index}]",
                    attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT
                )
                assert False, f"Error on turn {turn+1}: {next_response}\nMetadata: {next_metadata}"
    
            current_prompt, current_response = reply, next_response
    
        # If we exhausted max_turns without info/error, evaluate conversationally
        allure.attach(str(turns), name=f"Turns [{index}]", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
        convo_test_case = ConversationalTestCase(turns=turns)
        metric = self.ragmetric("conversational-professionalism")
        metric.measure(convo_test_case)
        allure.attach(str(metric.score), name=f"Score [{index}]", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
        allure.attach(str(metric.reason), name=f"Reason [{index}]", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
